The client responded to Q5: in the PJ (corporate) path, all cash is withdrawn in 2026 (single distribution in 2026). This supports the premise used in calculating IRRF (withholding income tax on distributions) of 695,600. No answers to the other questions (1, 2, 3, 4, 6) — no additional information from the client. These should be explicitly flagged as remaining unknowns, and the deliverables should be updated (no need to re-post already-answered questions).

Actions:
1. Update memorando.md (memorandum): Q5 confirmed → premise of single distribution in 2026 is now client-confirmed. Other unknowns remain flagged (dates, monetary correction, pre-2025 reserves, confirmation of 50/50 on profits, tax book value). Actually, the 50/50 split comes from the historical documents (Hélio 50%/Beatriz 50% of capital) — this is documented fact regarding capital. The distribution ratio likely follows this. Keep as a minor assumption but note it's based on the shareholding ratio in the file.
2. Update QUESTIONS.md — per instructions, "do not re-post already-answered questions." Remove Q5 (answered) and renumber the remaining unknowns. Or replace with an updated open-items list. Rewrite QUESTIONS.md with only unanswered items, noting that those are the remaining unknowns.
3. Update STATUS.md open items accordingly.
4. Numbers don't change: IRRF on single distribution in 2026 is exactly what was calculated (695,600). Confirmation also reinforces the conclusion: 60k monthly exemption over 59 months… let me double-check: with a single 2026 distribution, IRRF per partner = 10% × (3,528,000 − 50,000) = 347,800. Yes, no change.

Another refinement now that "all withdrawn in 2026" is confirmed: even if the distribution is stretched out, it would only save 10% × 50k per partner per month. Confirm the note.

Also, should I recheck the interpretation that only the excess over R$50k/month is taxed? Keep the flagged alternative interpretation (tax on the entire payment → IRRF 705,600, net 6,350,400, delta 9,200) — already mentioned in the memo body? Let me check the memo: "IRRF por sócio = 10% × (3.528.000 − 50.000)" (IRRF per partner = 10% × (3,528,000 − 50,000)) is stated, but in the final memo I didn't include the alternative interpretation note (that was in the earlier draft thinking). Let me check the memo file for whether the alternative interpretation is mentioned… in the section 4.3 I wrote, I mentioned a note on IRPFM not being verified, but did not mention the full-amount vs. excess-only reading. Add one line: if IRRF reaches the entire distributed amount (wording in the library ambiguous: "exceeding R$ 50,000/month per PJ"), IRRF = 705,600 and net = 6,350,400 (−9,200). Conclusion unchanged. This is honest and a good addition.

Update the deliverables with pinpoint edits:

Edit 1 — memorando.md §4.3: Mark the single-distribution-in-2026 premise as "confirmed by client (Hélio: 'pull it all out in 2026')" and add the alternative interpretation line.

Edit 2 — memorando.md §2 premises paragraph: Mark the distribution premise as confirmed. Others remain assumptions.

Edit 3 — memorando.md §8 items: Update — remove the "single distribution" unknown (confirmed), keep the rest, add full-amount vs. excess-only interpretation.

Edit 4 — QUESTIONS.md: Rewrite to contain only remaining unknowns (Q1 dates, Q2 monetary correction, Q3 pre-2025 reserves, Q6 tax book value/"shell"). Drop Q5. Q4: client replied no additional info — hmm, "For questions not answered above, the client has no additional information." This means they don't know / can't provide further. So should QUESTIONS.md be rewritten as "REMAINING UNKNOWNS (no answer from client — flagged as such)" rather than re-posting as questions. Rewrite with the heading "Remaining unknowns (client has no additional info)" and a one-liner stating Q5 has been answered.

Edit 5 — STATUS.md: Update open items — reflect the confirmation and the fact that client has no further information. Items remain open as unknowns. Status stays COMPLETE WITH OPEN ITEMS (unknowns flagged. Since client says no additional info, these are now "residual assumptions" rather than "awaiting response").

Let me write the edits.

Current text of memo §2: "**Premissas assumidas** (não consta dos documentos; ver QUESTIONS.md): fechamento em 2026, num único trimestre; distribuição de lucros da Proposta B aos sócios ainda em 2026, em parcela única acima de R$ 50 mil/mês por sócio; nenhum ajuste de preço entre "casca" e operação..."

Change to distinguish confirmed vs. assumed:
"**Premissas** — confirmadas pelo cliente: distribuição integral do caixa da Proposta B em 2026 (Hélio: "a gente tira o dinheiro todo em 2026"). Assumidas (cliente não tem mais informação; ver QUESTIONS.md): fechamento e a venda do estabelecimento发生 num único trimestre; distribuição em parcela única acima de R$ 50 mil/mês por sócio; proporção 50/50 para lucros (decorre do capital social do arquivo); nenhum ajuste..." — keep in clean Portuguese.

Edit to §4.3: After the IRRF calculation line "Em parcela única em 2026, R$ 3.528.000 por sócio:" (single installment in 2026, R$ 3,528,000 per partner) → "Em parcela única em 2026 — premissa confirmada pelo cliente —, R$ 3.528.000 por sócio:". Also, after the distribution-spread line, add: "*Leitura alternativa (texto da biblioteca ambíguo): se os 10% atingirem o valor integral distribuído, IRRF = 705.600 e líquido dos sócios = R$ 6.350.400 (diferença de R$ 9.200); conclusão inalterada.*" (Alternative reading (ambiguous library wording): if the 10% reaches the entire distributed amount, IRRF = 705,600 and net to partners = R$ 6,350,400 (difference of R$ 9,200); conclusion unchanged.)

Edit to §8: Replace the "Distribuição de lucros da "casca" em 2026 em parcela única (premissa do cálculo do IRRF)." (Distribution of "shell" profits in 2026 in a single installment (premise of IRRF calc)) item with a note that it's confirmed, and add the full-amount vs. excess-only interpretation item. Current §8 items:
- Final IRPFM calculation table…
- Exact date of closing and month of each installment…
- "Shell" profit distribution in 2026 in a single installment (premise of IRRF calc).
- Buyer's tax regime and…

Replace the third one with: "Proposta B: leitura do IRRF sobre o excedente de R$ 50 mil/mês (usado) vs. sobre o total distribuído — biblioteca não especifica; impacto ≈ R$ 9.200. Distribuição integral em 2026 foi confirmada pelo cliente." (Proposta B: IRRF read on the excess over R$ 50k/month (used) vs. on the total distributed — library doesn't specify; impact ≈ R$ 9,200. Full distribution in 2026 was confirmed by the client.)

Also, should I add unknowns on the 50/50 distribution and pre-2025 reserves and tax book value to §8? §8 already lists unverified items. Add: "Lucros apurados até 2025 com distribuição aprovada até 31/12/2025 (poderia reduzir IRRF da B); cliente não tem essa informação." (Profits assessed through 2025 with distribution approved through 12/31/2025 (could reduce IRRF on B); client doesn't have this information.) And "R$ 2.1 mi as fiscal book value" and 50/50. Keep concise — could be consolidated into 1-2 lines.

Then rewrite QUESTIONS.md and update STATUS.md.

Let me execute the edits now.

Client confirmed the key IRRF premise (full cash-out in 2026) — the computed R$ 695,600 / líquido R$ 6,360,400 stands unchanged. I'll update the deliverables to mark that premise confirmed, fold the remaining unanswered items into explicit flagged unknowns, and re-issue QUESTIONS.md without the answered question.
